description: NaFeGe₂O₆ is Esseneite structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.45-2.93 Å. Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent GeO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent FeO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.15 Å. Ge is bonded to four O atoms to form GeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent FeO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent GeO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 36-62°. There are a spread of Ge-O bond distances ranging from 1.75-1.79 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Fe, and one Ge atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to one Na, two equivalent Fe, and one Ge atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaFe₂Ge tetrahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Ge atoms.
